headline: GlowberryClient — Cosmetics & Identity Overhaul
summary: Cosmetics move onto the game's native renderer with 100+ capes, 256 accessories and 18 animated pets, plus Bedrock Optifine Mode, proximity voice chat and a hardened VIP Mod Menu.

items.text: Cosmetics now render through the game's own player-render hook, and the old resource-pack route is gone.
The cape is a 16-segment bone chain with real cloth fold driven by movement, jumping and turning.
100+ capes, 256 accessories and 18 animated 3D pets, built from authored models.
Cape artwork is swapped onto the real skin texture through the engine's own image loader.
The preview is sharper: alpha cutout, depth-correct occlusion and 2x supersampling.
Share your cape, hat and pet with other GlowberryClient users over LAN, the relay, or a manual peer.
A new Settings card with per-item toggles and launch wiring.
A classic black Optifine cape with the "OF" monogram is applied by default.
Voice works on your LAN and over a standalone relay server for internet play.
Public and private channels with shareable join codes, a live directory and a pixel mic meter.
Opus codec, jitter buffer, token auth and IP/device bans.
A bind-driven VIP Mod Menu with controller and keyboard layouts, hardened against crashes.
Record, review, trim, stitch and share clips without leaving your world.
Fixed the GlossHook linker-init crash that could take down the app.
Fixed dead cosmetics JNI exports so native cosmetics actually load.
Fixed preloader load order and missing signature rules.
Removed the news feature and reworked the Launch tab with docked controls and a live hero preview.
